current_evidence: The council's 'Planning application forms and checklists' page still lists 'Validation Checklist for a Full Planning Application' among its local validation checklists, the PDF itself reads 'Current version: July 2024', and a search found no newer Uttlesford local list.

issues.detail: List date 2026-03-01 is taken from PDF metadata (CreationDate), not the document text. The checklist states 'Current version: July 2024'. As a result, the 'Outdated (>2y)?' flag is wrong: a July 2024 list is more than 2 years old as of November 2026, but Grokbot marks it 'No'.
issues.evidence: Full Planning checklist header: 'Current version: July 2024', Amendment field blank; Date basis in workbook: 'PDF metadata CreationDate'.
issues.claude_response: Grok could not verify this, so the finding stands until someone checks it by hand.

issues.detail: Most 'Outline' rows (about 25) are sourced from 023_DFO_Validation_Checklist. In Uttlesford, DFO means 'Details Following Outline', i.e. Reserved Matters (the forms page lists it as 'Validation Checklist for Approval of Reserved Matters following outline permission'). So these requirements belong under Reserved matters, which Grokbot shows as '(none)'. Meanwhile the two outline checklists (005 Some Matters, 006 All Matters) were read but barely used for the Outline rows.
issues.evidence: Outline rows e.g. Affordable Housing, Arboricultural, CIL, Design Code, Fire Statement, Planning Statement, SCI, Viability all have source 023_DFO_Validation_Checklist.pdf; Reserved matters row: '(none)'.

issues.detail: Local requirements in the July 2024 Full Planning checklist that are not captured for Full planning (or at all): Noise and vibration impact assessment (noise-generating or noise-sensitive uses, mixed use); Archaeological assessment (site includes or may include a heritage asset of archaeological interest); Minerals infrastructure impact assessment and Waste infrastructure impact assessment (within 250m of minerals/waste infrastructure, 400m for Water Recycling Centres); Minerals resource assessment (Minerals Safeguarding Area: 5ha sand/gravel, 3ha chalk, >1 dwelling brickearth); Wildlife hazard risk assessment (within 13km of Cambridge aerodrome, bird-attracting development); Public right of way plan (PROW on, adjoining or affected); Schedule of materials (all applications with external materials); Waste management scheme (e.g. keeping horses, poultry or livestock); Memorandum of understanding (applications by or on behalf of UDC); Planning statement (all major development) and Community engagement report (majors of 10+ dwellings, retail of 1,000 sqm+) appear only under Outline/S73; Self-build declaration appears only under Outline; Amendment drawings (s73/s96A).
issues.evidence: Full Planning checklist rows: 'Minerals infrastructure impact assessment - Within 250 m...'; 'Wildlife hazard risk assessment - Development within 13 km of Cambridge aerodrome'; 'Schedule of materials - All applications with external materials'.

issues.detail: Several triggers are garbled column merges, or are the wrong text for the requirement. Affordable Housing Statement: 'wheelchair accessible Affordable Housing Statement What is required? If the level...' (actual: residential of 15 or more dwellings). Health Impact Assessment and Heritage Statement share the same nonsense excerpt 'Core Policy 32 Health Impact Assessment Heritage Statement iv. they adopt best practice...' (HIA actual: more than 200 residential units; Heritage: impact on designated/non-designated heritage assets, Conservation Areas, Article 4 areas). Land Contamination: 'Development proposals of 50 to 99 dwellings or 1,000m2 to 4,999m2...' (actual: known/suspected contamination, sensitive uses, or within 250m of former landfill). Fire Statement: '18m or Fire Statement Form having 7 storeys or more Airport Safeguarding Cambridge requested...'.
issues.evidence: Full Planning checklist: Affordable housing 'Residential development of 15 or more dwellings'; HIA 'More than 200 residential units'; Land contamination 'within 250 m of a former landfill'.

issues.detail: Householder triggers are also merged across columns. Biodiversity Checklist: 'Biodiversity Survey and Report All applications A drawing showing the visibility splay...'. Arboricultural: '...Tree Survey & Report All applications where there The Public Right of Way should be displayed...'. Parking plan: 'Heritage Statement Parking Plan residential), where they development would be affected by sources of flooding' (actual: garage conversions, more bedrooms, or building over a parking space). Environmental Statement (Full): 'An EcIA report (or the ecological chapter of an EIA)...' is ecology text, not an EIA trigger. Daylight/Sunlight: 'All submissions must include an overshadowing study' omits that it applies only to major developments with potential adverse light impacts.
issues.evidence: Full Planning checklist: 'Parking plan - Garage conversions, more bedrooms, or building over a parking space'; 'Daylight/sunlight assessment - Major developments with potential adverse light impacts'.

issues.detail: Misplaced rows. Retail Impact Assessment is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval', but the checklist trigger is retail/leisure proposals over 2,499 sqm in planning applications. Transport Assessment and Travel Plan are placed under 'County own devt (Reg 3)' although Uttlesford is a district and these come from the Full Planning checklist (the district's own-development item is the Memorandum of understanding). 'Design Code / Masterplan' is under Householder, but the Urban Design Code checklist applies to majors. The Advertisement 'Block plan' row is sourced from the Outline (005) checklist.
issues.evidence: Full Planning checklist: 'Urban Design Code checklist - Majors, once the Design Code is adopted'; 'Retail impact assessment and sequential test - Proposals above 2,499 sqm'.

issues.detail: The council publishes type-specific checklists that Grokbot did not use, yet it reports '(none)' for those types. Lawful development cert (two CLEUD/CLOPUD checklists), Reserved matters (DFO checklist, see above), householder prior approval (Class A larger extensions checklist), and Demolition in cons area (Full Planning and Conservation Area Consent checklist 007, which was read). The 32 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' rows are also unnecessary, since every row is in a type-specific checklist (e.g. AH and Contamination under Full are sourced from the Outline All Matters checklist 006).
issues.evidence: Forms page: 'Validation Checklist for a Certificate of Lawfulness for Proposed Use...', 'Validation Checklist for Householder Prior Approvals, Class A, Part 1, Schedule 2', 'Validation Checklist for Approval of Reserved Matters following outline permission'.

issues.detail: Many tab items are glossary, advice or garbled link text rather than requirements. Policy-driven items are definitions ('For SPA's this includes qualifying species...', 'This includes candidate Special Areas of Conservation... regulation 8', 'Those plants or animals found on the legal list of qualifying species', 'Natural England Interactive map displaying information about SPA...'). Advice includes 'It is strongly recommended that you seek advice from Natural England'. Officer-check text includes 'Check the title on the statement relates to the proposal...'. 'Submission rules' items are URL fragments ('London Stanstead Airport ... shing.service.gov.u k/governmen t/uploads...'). App-type rows include 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' ('can obtain Pre-application Advice from Natural England') and 'Validation checklist form (completed)', which just repeats the biodiversity checklist instruction.
issues.evidence: Tab items in 'Policy-driven requirements', 'Local forms / checklists' and 'Submission rules' sections.

issues.detail: The 23 drawing-standards items contain repeated text from the different checklists: 'A recognised scale (1:0, 1:100...)' x2, 'A SCALE BAR MUST BE INCLUDED ON ALL DRAWINGS' x2, 'Be included for all elevations affected...' x2, 'The plan can be hand drawn...' x2, 'Is drawn to an identified metric scale' x2. Several others are column-merged gibberish ('This should To prevent the relate to annotated elevations...').

The 'Validation list URL' points to only the Full Planning checklist. Uttlesford's local list is a suite of about 17 type-specific checklists on the 'Planning application forms and checklists' page, plus separate biodiversity, land contamination, fire statement and self-build proformas. The reference link would be better pointed at that page.
issues.evidence: uttlesford.gov.uk/planning-application-forms-and-checklists lists Householder, Full, Full+LB, Full+CA, Advert, Full+Advert, LBC, Outline (some/all), Reserved Matters, CLEUD, CLOPUD, Householder prior approval and S73 checklists.

summary: Grokbot's link is to Uttlesford's current Full Planning checklist, but the List date comes from PDF metadata (the text says July 2024, so the list is now over 2 years old). Reserved Matters (DFO) requirements are mislabelled as Outline, several local requirements are missed (noise, archaeology, minerals/waste safeguarding, aerodrome wildlife hazard, PROW, schedule of materials), and many triggers are garbled column merges.
